direction: Run one clean benchmark experiment using a direct LightGBM Tweedie recipe with native categorical handling. Choose sensible moderate-complexity parameters for French Motor burning cost, and focus on producing a reliable first challenger to the global-mean baseline.
starting_knowledge: This is the first delegation in a fresh five-cycle campaign; the current champion is the global mean.
constraints: Run exactly one experiment and finish the delegation.
Prefer a declarative recipe; do not write a novel model script.
Keep the single-fit runtime comfortably within the comparison budget.
success_criteria: Produce a calibrated non-baseline challenger with materially positive weighted Gini, or a clear diagnostic explaining failure.
